narrative.overview:
The site is a darkroom session for one career. Every project goes through the same stations (built, shipped, measured), and its result is a print that develops in front of the reader. With the lights on, safelight amber floods the whole ground and deeproom brown is the ink. A soft, brighter pool of safelight sits behind the opening claim. Dark bands of deeproom brown hold the prints: the contact sheet under the masthead, the mid-page Writing zone, the closing contact field and every case-study header. The prints are the only neutral tones on the page, silver-gray up to enamel white, inside white borders like an 8×10. With the lights off, the room goes dark. The ground turns deeproom brown and the safelight becomes the ink.

Type follows a lab-label voice. Claims are Archivo set in extreme condensed capitals (width 62%) at wall scale. Labels, dates, timer-like figures and spec rows are Martian Mono at 11 to 13px. Reading text is Archivo at normal width. Structure comes from 2px brown rules and 1px hairlines, with square corners and no shadows. State is carried by development. A fixed print is full contrast with a solid white edge. A developing print is flat and low contrast, with a dashed edge and a dated note saying when its measurement is due.

The system rejects the dark hero with an avatar over a card grid, the cream editorial column, and the red Flight Record it replaced. There is no red anywhere. Density is that of a session log: ruled, scannable, with the measured evidence printed at display size and everything else small.
keyCharacteristics: Safelight amber as the ground (light theme); deeproom brown as the ground with amber ink (dark theme). No red.
Deeproom bands hold the prints; inside a band, amber is the only type colour.
Silver-gray prints with white borders carry every measured figure.
State by development: fixed is full contrast and solid-edged; developing is low contrast, dashed and dated.
Archivo extreme condensed caps (width 62%) for claims; Martian Mono annotations at 11px.
2px brown rules for structure, 1px hairlines for rows, square corners, no shadows.

rules.name: The No Red Rule
rules.body: No red, coral or red-orange appears anywhere: not in tokens, fills, charts, focus rings, OG cards or the favicon. Amber, brown and silver are the whole palette.

rules.name: The Deeproom Band Rule
rules.body: A deeproom band does not get its own components. The band re-points `--color-ink`, `--color-muted`, `--color-faint`, `--color-rule`, `--color-accent`, `--color-accent-text` and `--color-focus` to the on-field values, and the shared rows render amber on brown without changes. Focus rings inside a band turn on-field amber.

rules.name: The Silver Only On Prints Rule
rules.body: The print tones (print-hi, print-lo, print-ink) appear only on prints and on the test strip. They are never used for interface text, backgrounds or borders anywhere else.

rules.name: The AA Everywhere Rule
rules.body: Every text token clears WCAG AA (4.5:1) on paper and paper-2 in both themes, and amber clears it on the deeproom. A new text colour has to ship with its ratio.

rules.name: The Lab Label Rule
rules.body: Claims are extreme condensed (width 62%) heavy capitals, and condensed type reopens its word gaps (word-spacing 0.08 to 0.14em).

rules.name: The Scale Courage Rule
rules.body: Claims go to wall scale and annotations stay at 11px, with very little in between. Nothing on the site is set below 0.6875rem.

rules.name: The Mono Width Rule
rules.body: Martian Mono is always set at font-stretch 87.5%. Every `time` element and every column of figures uses tabular lining numerals.

rules.name: The Flat Room Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow, no drop-shadow, no translate-up on hover. Emphasis comes from a heavier rule, a deeproom band or a print.

rules.name: The Development State Rule
rules.body: State is carried by development, not by hue. A fixed print is full contrast with a solid white edge. A developing print is a flat, unlit sheet (print-lo, no highlight) with a dashed edge, and always carries a text note naming when its measurement is due. The fog lives in the paper, never in the figure: the number keeps 5.3:1 against the flat sheet.

rules.name: The Exposure Rule
rules.body: Order through time is shown as exposure. The test strip darkens step by step from silver toward print black at now, and the current step is the tallest and darkest.

dos: **Do** keep the palette to safelight amber, deeproom brown and silver print tones, in both themes.
**Do** give dark ground to whole bands (contact sheet, Writing zone, closing field, case-study header, hovered card), and re-point the tokens inside them instead of forking components.
**Do** print every measured figure: silver gradient, white border, print-ink figure at width 62%.
**Do** carry pending results as developing: low contrast, dashed edge, and a text note with the due date.
**Do** run every project through the same Built / Shipped / Measured stations.
**Do** set claims as Archivo heavy capitals at width 62%, and annotations in Martian Mono at 0.6875rem and font-stretch 87.5%.
**Do** use tabular lining figures for every date and column of numbers.
**Do** use the drawn SVG arrow pair for every link arrow. Typographic arrows are allowed only inside date ranges such as "2018 → now".
**Do** ship every new text colour with a contrast ratio that clears AA on paper and paper-2 in both themes, and on the deeproom.
donts: **Don't** use red, coral or red-orange anywhere: not in tokens, charts, focus rings, OG images or icons.
**Don't** use print silver or white outside prints and the test strip.
**Don't** put an eyebrow or kicker above a heading.
**Don't** round a corner or cast a shadow, and don't lift or scale on hover.
**Don't** show a glowing status dot. Live status is a solid bar.
**Don't** fall back to a dark hero with an avatar over a card grid, a cream editorial column, or the red Flight Record.
